newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks dip at close on poor turnover.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks dip at close on poor turnover.

text.p: Dhaka stocks lost 2.9 percent as wary speculators maintained selling pressure for a third straight session, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 93.56 points, or 2.9 percent, to 3,124.11. Of 82 traded issues, 71 lost, eight rose and three were unchanged. Turnover was 14.8 million taka, the lowest in recent months, brokers said. "Most investors prefered to keep to the sidelines in a falling market. It is suddenly an all sellers' market," said one broker.
Apex Foods fell 804.66 taka to 15,286.63 and Beximco Pharma lost 21.85 to 415.30. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
